Clause 9.35.3 - heritage: Heritage Conservation Areas (HCAs)

Clause 9.32.3(a) - heritage: Parramatta Road Commercial Precinct Heritage Conservation Area (HCA 5)

Clause 9.35.4 - other: Precinct -specific planning controls

Clause 9.35.5 - other: Site-specific planning controls

Clause PART 9 - setback (development_control): a nil  setback

Clause PART 9 - parking (development_control): private parking area

Clause PART 9 - height_limit (development_control): Building heights are mostly 2 to 3 storeys,
interspersed with some larger buildings. The shop top housing developments  at the 
eastern end of the precinct are up to 7 store ys high.

Clause PART 9 - heritage (heritage): Heritage Items within the precinct include part of Fort Street High School  (William
Wilkins Building) , the Cl arence Hotel  on the eastern corner  with Crystal Street , 
Petersham Inn Hotel  on the western corner with Phillip Street, the Olympia Milk Bar at 
190 Parramatta Road,  a five storey  Federation  building  on the eastern corner with 
Cardigan Street which  has rec ently being redeveloped and Bridge R oad School
